properties.description: the_blast_radius_of_a_change_is_read_whole_in_pages.rs, over the MCP surface: a core part ninety long-named parts depend on, and a change that touched it. propagate_change full:true at the default budget fits 30,000; at budget_chars 6,000 every page fits, impacted_page says offset/shown/total/next_offset, and paging by offset to the end reads all 90 rows exactly once; propagate_from pages by the same serializer; an offset without full is refused by name; a change touching all 90 parts fits 4,000 summary and full, naming its silent seeds once under stale_edge_evidence_silent_on with the count kept. tools/replies_are_bounded.py now also calls propagate_change on the export's widest change (most CHANGED edges) with full:true and checks budget_chars binds.
properties.findings: On main 02e2739c8 the paging tests FAIL: propagate_change refuses budget_chars as an unknown field and propagate_from refuses offset; replies_are_bounded.py run against the 0.92.0 binary FAILS on propagate_change (2,748,341 characters, no budget_chars). A first fix still answered 80,151 to a 30,000 budget on reflow2's design (the gate caught it: 541 per-seed coverage notes, 55,599 characters, and 579 seed ids nothing shortened); with the silent seeds grouped and the seed lists giving rows, all 5 tests pass (cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --test in_memory, 2026-10-26).
properties.name: A change's blast radius fits its budget and is read whole in pages
